parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the PolarDB cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~) operation to query available regions.

parameters.name: ResourceControlName
parameters.description: The name of the resource control rule. The name must be 1 to 63 ASCII bytes in length, start with a letter, and can contain only letters, digits, and underscores.

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description: The type of the binding target. Valid values: USER, DATABASE, QUERY, CONNECTION. The value is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: TargetValue
parameters.description: The value of the binding target. The format depends on the value of TargetType. For more information, see the table below.
